citation: Cuneiform Digital Library Initiative (CDLI). Ongoing. Open catalog of cuneiform artifacts (including proto-cuneiform / archaic texts), with museum provenances, periods, and images where available. Project historically associated with UCLA / partners; public site https://cdli.earth/ (accessed 2026-10-11).
notes: Living digital catalog aggregating museum and excavation tablet records. Treat individual artifact pages as primary catalog entries (check period labels and museum numbers on the artifact record). Not a substitute for excavation reports when claiming findspot context. Englund and collaborators’ archaic-text editions are closely linked to CDLI publication records.

editorial.notes: Copied from source registry front matter; no new bibliographic claims.
